title: Simulador Oficial Completo TOEIC® - Versión 10
description: Simulador completo real de Listening & Reading enfocado en Summit Media y el líder the CEO.

parts.visual:
## 📝 Simulador Oficial TOEIC® (Versión 10)

Evaluación de **Listening & Reading** en tiempo real:

1. **Listening Section**: Evalúa tu comprensión en Summit Media usando ActiveCRM.
2. **Reading Section**: Mide tu análisis gramatical de memorandos emitidos por the CEO.

*Inicia tu prueba simulada oficial.*
parts.audio: Welcome to the Full TOEIC Simulation. Manage your time efficiently across both listening and reading stages. Let's begin.

questions.question: [PART 1 - PHOTO]: Select the best description of Summit Media's office photo.
questions.audio_script: A) They are drawing the organizational chart. B) They are leaving the executive boardroom. C) The strategy office is empty. D) They are reviewing the corporate acquisition plan.
questions.explanation: Se observa a la mesa directiva analizando el organigrama y el dossier de adquisición estratégica.

questions.question: [PART 3 - CONVERSATION]: Listen to the dialogue and answer: What does the man agree to do next?
questions.audio_script:
M: Hi Robert, did you review the expansion plan from Summit Media?
W: Yes, the CEO sent it. All departmental goals must be mapped under ActiveCRM.
M: I will synchronize the task boards today.
options: Sign the contract as currently written.
Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
Write a new memorandum to sales staff.
questions.correct_answer: Call the manager to negotiate an extension of the delivery window.
questions.explanation: El hombre dice: 'I will call their manager to negotiate an extension'.

questions.question:
[PART 5]: Complete the business sentence correctly:

"All employees are strictly required to comply ___ the updated security rules in ActiveCRM."
questions.explanation: El verbo 'comply' rige gramaticalmente la preposición 'with' (comply with / cumplir con).

questions.question:
[PART 7]: Read the memorandum and answer: **When will the migration to ActiveCRM officially occur?**

**MEMORANDUM**

*To:* Division Heads
*From:* Chief Executive Officer
*Subject: Corporate Strategy & ActiveCRM Targets*

Please note that starting next Monday, all quarterly key performance indicators must be logged in ActiveCRM. An alignment meeting will be held this weekend at 5:00 PM in the Conference West Wing.
questions.explanation: El memorando dice: 'starting next next Monday, we are officially retiring our legacy sales tool and migrating to ActiveCRM'.
